You catch the straight line of the spell in your thoughts and pull one bright thread sideways.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self or one visible willing ally within 4 squares, before defending against a single-target spell from a visible caster within 4 squares of you.
Type
Magic / Defense / Movement

The recipient gains 2 Boons to the defense. On a Strong defense, after the spell resolves, it may move 1 square without provoking.
